    end;

    FunctionLibrary.SetCurrencyVisible("Shop", p44 and {
        ForceCurrency = true,

    });
    script_Parent.Enabled = p44;
    FunctionLibrary.UIBlur(p44);

                    v48 = child;

                end;

            u6 = v48;
            u5 = CatalogItem;
            ClearDescription();
            BlueprintDescription(CatalogItem);

    else
        LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.Main.Enabled = true;
    end;
end;

function FillBlueprints()

    local Blueprints = ReplicatedStorage.Catalog:FindFirstChild("Blueprints");

    for _, child in pairs(Blueprints:GetChildren()) do
        if not child:FindFirstChild("Unlisted") then
            local v54 = Templates.Interface.ShopBlueprints:Clone();
            v54.Cost.Value = child.Cost.Value;
            v54.Cost.CostType.Value = child.Cost.CostType.Value;
            v54.Image = child.Picture.Value;

            v54.Name = child.Name;
            Item.Value = Name;

                v54.PriceLabel.Visible = true;
            elseif Value2 == "Candy" then
                v54.PriceLabel.TextLabel.Text = FunctionLibrary.CommaFormat(Value);
                v54.PriceLabel.TextLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(223, 66, 255);
                v54.PriceLabel.Visible = true;
            elseif Value2 == "Scrap" then
                v54.PriceLabel.TextLabel.Text = FunctionLibrary.CommaFormat(Value);
                v54.PriceLabel.TextLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(177, 177, 177);
                v54.PriceLabel.Visible = true;
            else
                v54.PriceLabel.Visible = false;
            end;

            if child:FindFirstChild("Description") then
                v54.Description.Value = child.Description.Value;
            end;

            v54.Parent = Catalog.Frame.Blueprints.List;
        end;
    end;
end;

function PerkDescription()

        Catalog.Summary.Buy.Label.Text = "Owned";
    end;

function ConfigureItem(p87, p88)

    local ItemData = u3.GetItemData(u17, p87, p88);

    end;

    if not Id then
        return false, "Asset id not found";
    end;

    local success, result = pcall(function() -- Line: 1006
        -- upvalues: MarketplaceService (ref), Id (copy)
        return MarketplaceService:GetProductInfo(Id);
    end);
    local CatalogItem = u3.GetCatalogItem(Id);
    local ContentFrame = EditTab.Body.ContentFrame;

    if success and result then
        local Name = result.Creator.Name;
        ContentFrame.Description.CreatorFrame.Subtitle.Text = Name;
        ContentFrame.Description.CreatorFrame.Visible = Name ~= "Roblox";
        ContentFrame.Description.ProductFrame.IdBox.Text = Id or "";
        ContentFrame.Description.ProductFrame.Visible = true;
        ContentFrame.Description.PurchaseFrame.Visible = result.IsForSale;
        ContentFrame.Description.PurchaseFrame.Purchase.Label.Text = `{FunctionLibrary.CommaValue(result.PriceInRobux)} Robux`;
    else
        ContentFrame.Description.CreatorFrame.Visible = false;
        ContentFrame.Description.ProductFrame.Visible = false;
        ContentFrame.Description.PurchaseFrame.Visible = false;
    end;

    EditTab.Icon.Label.Text = CatalogItem and (CatalogItem.Label or CatalogItem.Name or (CatalogItem.ProductName or "Custom Catalog Access Item")) or "Custom Catalog Access Item";
    EditTab.Icon.ImageLabel.Image = `rbxthumb://type={CatalogItem and CatalogItem.IsBundle and "BundleThumbnail" or "Asset"}&id={Id}&w=150&h=150`;
    u24 = p87;
    u23 = p88;
    UpdateTuningSliders(p87, ItemData);
    EditTab.Visible = true;
end;
